quarterly_data.quarter: SK Telecom IR presentation: Q2 2026 results (08-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 results deck: AI DC revenue KRW 136.2bn vs KRW 70.7bn in Q2 2025 (+92.5% YoY) and KRW 131.4bn in Q1 2026 (+3.6% QoQ), attributed to higher utilization of DCs and increased revenue contribution from submarine cable; AI B2B/B2C revenue KRW 61.3bn (+24.5% YoY) on orders for Cloud business. Submarine cables: SJC2 (Japan, Korea, Hong Kong, Singapore; 10,500 km) launched July 2025; E2A (U.S., Korea, Japan, Taiwan; 12,500 km) scheduled to launch in 2029, with further expansion across Asia planned. SKB revenue KRW 1,160.3bn (+3.6% YoY) driven by continued growth of DC business; CapEx KRW 487.0bn in Q2 2026 vs KRW 635.0bn in Q2 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: AI DC rev KRW 136.2bn (+92.5% YoY); AI B2B/B2C KRW 61.3bn (+24.5%); Q2 CapEx KRW 487.0bn

quarterly_data.signal: AI data center expansion plan (Q2 2026 deck): SK Hyper, established July 2026 and 100% owned, will spearhead AI data center business development by proactively securing sites, building and operating substations, developing transmission & distribution infra and acquiring tenants. Expansion is sequential in line with market demand: 137MW as-is (2026), 5GW Phase 1 with phased opening beginning from 2029, and 15GW Phase 2.
